question: The enzyme Alpha-Amylase is present in the ___________ of the human body.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saliva**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Saliva contains enzymes like **amylase**, which begins the process of breaking down **carbohydrates** in the mouth, kickstarting digestion even before food reaches the stomach.
 
• Saliva helps **neutralize acids** in the mouth, which are produced by bacteria after eating. This helps prevent tooth **decay and enamel erosion.**
